claim: Trapping detection is not validated. Synthetic exclusion tests are software checks only.
independentLabelRequirements: Separate terrain-sand appearance, measured rover slip and measured astronaut sinkage tasks.
Use before-traversal predictions and independently sourced outcome labels with traceable URLs or dataset IDs.
Keep adjacent frames, spatially adjacent observations and whole drive episodes in the same split.
Choose thresholds using development data only; record protocol before opening test outcomes.
Do not reinterpret NASA AI4Mars terrain classes as measured sinkage or borrowing another model's reported accuracy.
Report unscored observations and coverage, confusion counts, precision, recall, F1, false-positive rate and average precision.
Audit temporal alignment, co-registration, uncertainty and source independence externally. JSON declarations are not proof.

rowFields.episode: drive/location group shared by correlated observations
rowFields.score: prediction in [0,1], or null for unknown
rowFields.label: 0 or 1 from independent outcomes under a preregistered definition
rowFields.beforeTraversal: true only when predictor inputs precede the outcome
